records.printedFlavorText: The Threat has shown itself. Now is the time to strike! Find its lair and eradicate it.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Set up this Dungeon according to the Boss Quest rules. You can't return to the Hamlet before you defeat the Boss!

records.printedFlavorText: It all starts with a threat known as the Uca Major. A malevolent eldritch nightmare that ravages the depths of the cove. Head down there and finds its lair, and deliver us from this evil crustacean horror's influence.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms always spawn 1 Uca Major first and then the rest of the Monsters from the Monster Deck as normal.

records.printedFlavorText: It's time you mapped out more of the underground network deep in the coves. Swim to the submerged grotto and there you'll find an entrance to the vast caverns. Explore as much as you can and map out the area carefully. No one knows what lurks down there.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms.

records.printedFlavorText: The emerging threat from the cove can mean only one thing, that the eldritch signs etched to the grotto's walls have been corrupted. Take these potions and imbue them once more with the arcane energy they require. Keep them active, to protect us from the evil that resides down there.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Set aside Room Cards [cove]1 and [cove]9. When entering an Objective Room, draw one of those cards at random and at the end of the encounter set it aside again. At the start of the Quest you can turn any Provision to [potion]. Once per battle, when a Hero is in an Area [red-area] of an Objective Room they can discard a Potion to purify the Eldritch Sign.

records.printedFlavorText: Now that the waters of the cove have receded, it's high time you ventured there and collected a good deal of samples. Not barnacles and dead fish mind you, but the clues that will shed some light onto what lives down there, and what threats you are about to face in the imminent future...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Set aside Room Cards [cove]2, [cove]5, and [cove]8, when entering an Objective Room, draw one of those cards at random. When a Hero is in an Area [A] of an Objective Room, they can spend 2 actions to gather a sample. Keep track of the samples by placing Wounds on the Quest Card. The Quest Card can not have more than 6 [wound].

records.printedFlavorText: The murky waters of the cove didn't used to be as such. The mere presence of its unholy denizens threatens our very own existence. If you don't put an end to them, it's going to turn into a fetid pool of virulent sickness. Head down there and clean the fetid lair. Halt the contamination for good.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: When a Hero kills a Cove Monster they suffer 2[blight] 3t.

records.printedFlavorText: The madness has not yet ended, for a Uca Major plagues the tumultuous waters of the cove. No matter how many you kill, they always come back for more. Find out why, and end them once and for all...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms always spawn 1 Uca Major and 1 Squiffy Ghast first and then 1 more Monster from the Monster Deck.

records.printedFlavorText: You have been there more than once. Yet we know little of the area we call the cove. Now that the tide is low, you should venture there once more and map out the underground caverns carefully. We know that something sinister lives there, yet we can't fathom where it resides.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms.

records.printedFlavorText: You have braved many dangers, but not the eldritch nightmares of the cove. We have found the places of power where they gather and perform their sacrilegious ceremonies. Deep into the underground grotto, you should find them there. Do your job and make sure they never return...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms. After clearing a Curio Room, suffer only the negative effects of a Curio Card.

records.printedFlavorText: These horrific fish-nightmares reside deep in the cove's rancid lairs. Yet we still haven't located them, and that's what you should do. Head down there and brave the cove's dangers. Find the place they live in and put them to the sword!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are Rooms [cove]2, [cove]5, [cove]6 & [cove]8. Set these Rooms aside at the Dungeon start, and pick one of them at random each time you enter an Objective Room. Spawn only Cove Monsters in Objective Rooms.

records.printedFlavorText: Rancid, fetid, and obscene. That's how the cove waters smell nowadays. Yet we know that the unclean lairs hidden in its depths are the cause of it all. Swim down there and put an end to this, quickly and efficiently.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: When a Hero kills a Cove Monster they suffer 3[blight] 3t.

records.printedFlavorText: It is painful to ask, but you should head down the cove once more. But now the situation is much more dire. The creatures that reside there have grown restless. Thus you should go down there and ransack their lairs. But try to remain unfazed by the creeping madness that resides behind its wet walls...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms. After clearing a Curio Room suffer only the negative effects of a Curio Card.

records.printedFlavorText: All that glitters is not gold, some treasures bear a curse untold. These tainted trinkets are waiting for you to be purified, lest we risk getting corrupted by their demonic influence. You know how...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are: [cove]1, [cove]5, [cove]9. Each Hero gets 1 level 3 Trinket at random, those Trinkets are considered tainted. If a Hero can't get a Trinket, they choose one of theirs to become tainted. When in an Objective Room, a Hero can spend one action in Area [red-area] (this can be done only once per Room) to cleanse the Trinket and score one objective. Upon returning to Hamlet, each Hero with a tainted Trinket can suffer 2 negative Quirks and cleanse it, or remove it and shuffle it back into its respective deck.

records.printedFlavorText: The most dangerous of these fish-monsters have yet to be put to the sword! Thus, you have one final task. Head down, deep in their lairs, and find these abominable deep ones. Make sure they never swim up to the surface for vengeance...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are Rooms [cove]2, [cove]5, [cove]6 & [cove]8. Set these Rooms aside at the Dungeon start, and pick one of them at random each time you enter an Objective Room. Spawn 1 Squiffy Ghast and only Cove Monsters in Objective Rooms.

records.printedFlavorText: Long ago, a ship filled with idols was lost ashore. Its wreckage was never found, yet the lingering influence of the idols remains up to this day. The monsters are aware of their corrupting influence. Thus, you must go down to the cove's depths and find them... and destroy them...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Room [cove]7 is the Objective Room. When searching in [green-area] Areas, rolling 4-8 will give you an idol in place of the provision of your choice. Only one idol can be found per shipwreck.

records.printedFlavorText: The waters are still poisonous, and even though you've tried as much, you can only do one final thing to end the spreading of its disease. Head down to the rancid lair, ransack it, and make sure that no unclean horror emerges from it... ever...again.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: When a Hero kills a Cove Monster they suffer 3[blight] 4t.

records.printedFlavorText: We never used to venture into the swamp, for we were certain that nothing existed there. However, things have changed now and something vile festers there. Venture into the swamp and find out what's going on out there.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: The courtiers and the bureaucrats of the once noble estate are no more. But their treasures and valuables are still out there, corroding in the humidity of the swamp. Find them and bring them back, for we need them more than they do.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: The first Loot Chest in each Objective Room contains a Valuable instead of the normal boon. Spawn only Rooms with loot as Objective Rooms.

records.printedFlavorText: The courtiers of the past rest out there, sleeping in their coffins. You should put an end to them, lest we allow them to walk on these grounds and bring an end to us sooner or later. Put them out of their misery and destroy their tombs. Hurry... before the day ends!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Clearing Curio Rooms causes Heroes to desecrate a tomb. Curios from these Rooms only ever have negative effects which cannot be countered by a Torch.

records.printedFlavorText: The water near the Hamlet has been contaminated and we've traced the source back to the swamp. We need you to go there, get some samples, and bring them here to study so that we find a way to reverse this before it is too late.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are Rooms [court]2, [court]3 & [court]4. When you enter choose one at random and discard it when cleared. When in Area A [red-area] of these Rooms, a Hero must spend 2 actions to fill up a vial with blood. Rooms are cleared only if a vial is filled up.

records.printedFlavorText: Deep in the night, the denizens of the Courtyard convene in unholy gatherings. Performing ill rituals of darkness and despair. Go there and end these gatherings. Slaughter them.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Spawn only [court] Monsters in Lairs.

records.printedFlavorText: Even after so many years, the Courtyard remains a conundrum. Yet no single soul knows of how vast it is and the overgrowing foliage makes it ever so difficult. Go there and make a small map, so we can mount future expeditions in the future.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: Decades ago, the Courtyard was built on top of a drained swamp; now the wilderness of the moor has returned to reclaim what men have taken from nature. Buildings are slowly sinking into the growing swamp, and Crocodilians once driven from their ancestral homes are recolonizing the overgrown gardens. Drive them away, lest more innocents become their prey.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Lairs, Spawn 1 Crocodilian (Level III)

records.printedFlavorText: More terrible insects and dangerous pests infest the once magnificent gardens. Their incessant buzzing reminds us of the danger lurking in the swamp. Go there and eradicate them swiftly. Make sure that none remain.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: Decadent nobles, fallen to the darkness, are hosting nightmarish parties and galas, spreading sickness and sin alike. Crash their parties and put them to the blade, make sure that none survive.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are Rooms [court]5, [court]6 & [court]7. When you enter choose one at random and discard it when cleared. Spawn only [court] Monsters in Objective Rooms.

records.printedFlavorText: The sickly nobility of the Courtyard has stolen heirlooms most dear and valuable. Take them back!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Courtyard Monsters in Objective Rooms have +7 Life. For the objective pieces, only draw from chests, as the first chest looted always grants a Level 2 Trinket card. Upon returning to the Hamlet, you can give any LvL 2 Trinkets to the Heir of your choice to gain the Xp (Maximum 3, and you lose those Trinkets). One Objective Room must be cleared as a minimum to do so.

records.printedFlavorText: You must have heard of the Crocodilians. The dangerous animals that spread sickness and death along their path. They're preying in the swamp on the hapless Hamlet folk. Find their den and put their nests to the torch. Drive them away for good.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are Rooms [court]4, [court]5 & [court]9. When entering, choose one at random and discard it when cleared. Always spawn 1 Crocodilian and 1 Adder there.

records.printedFlavorText: Obscene monstrosities litter the Courtyard with their abominable presence. Eradicate them all. Bring peace to the once grandiose and serene garden, if even for a night.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Courtyard Monsters deal an additional [on-hit] 3[bleed] 3t and Self [heal]4 when they hit you.

sourceBlockers.printedQuote: Clearing Curio Rooms causes Heroes to a tomb.
sourceBlockers.reason: A verb is missing from the printed sentence. Do not copy the action from the Level I card. Other printed rules remain readable.

records.printedFlavorText: The courtiers of the past rest out there, sleeping in their coffins. You should put an end to them, lest we allow them to walk on these grounds and bring an end to us sooner or later. Put them out of their misery and destroy their tombs. Hurry... before the day ends!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Curio Rooms always have Battle. Clearing Curio Rooms causes Heroes to a tomb. Curios there have only negative effects that cannot be countered with a Torch.

records.printedFlavorText: The swamp - as vast as our miseries - remains a mystery to all of us. Scout the area ahead and track as much as you can. Otherwise we will not be able to mount any expeditions in the future.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Setup the Dungeon with random Rooms. Each time the party moves away from a cleared Room, replace the Room with a random Room Token (face-down). This Room is considered as though you haven't passed through it.

records.printedFlavorText: The vampire court has convened yet again. Plotting and scheming against the hapless survivors of the Hamlet. Crash their decadent party, eradicate them all and keep the sickness away. Finish. Them. For. Good.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are [court]6, [court]7, [court]8. Always spawn 2 Courtesans and 2 Chevaliers there.

records.printedFlavorText: A revered ancestor was laid to rest in the ruins, their sacred bones left untouched. But what is dead should remain as such. Thus, the noble duty fell upon your shoulders - to retrieve them, lest they fall prey to the dark taint of the land.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are [ruins]7. A Hero must spend 2 actions in the [green-area] Area to recover the bones. Set aside the room [ruins]7 at the start of the quest; you will not use it in other meetings. Objective Rooms are cleared only if the bones have been collected.

records.printedFlavorText: Wealth brings wealth, and to this estate's noble destitute family this was only but a saying. However, the owner was adamant that various riches could be found in the ruins: "Venture through the ruins and take back what was ours! Bring wealth and glory back to our noble family!"
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: One Lair Room must be cleared as the minimum Quest goal. Clearing Lairs awards 10[gold].
records.printedReward: After the Quest is over, you can give any amount of Gold to the Heir, gaining 1 Xp/20[gold] given.

records.printedFlavorText: Time passes and the demons grow stronger, casting a heavier shadow upon your very existence. That's why you were tasked to enter the ruins and cull their numbers, putting them to the sword...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Curio Rooms always have Battles. When spawning Monsters in Curio Rooms, draw 1 Level 2 Monster.

records.printedFlavorText: The estate has remained secret for far too long... Thus, it was the rightful owner's decision to send you on a mission to scout ahead. Who knew what horrors lurked in the shadows though?
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: The Monsters' unholy presence tainted the very opulent halls of this estate, casting dark shadows over its ruins. Thus, your orders were quite clear: "Slay them all!"
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: Thin their numbers. Nothing can be achieved if their leaders remain intact. Thus, you're tasked to find them and eradicate them once and for all.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Objective Rooms, spawn 1 Bone Bearer (Level III)

records.printedFlavorText: The path ahead in the ruins is littered by fearsome terrors and the nightmarish cult. Put an end to them, clear the path once and for all!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: As the cult's ominous rituals taint the halls of the ruins, dark gods begin to converge over the estate. This cannot be left unanswered. Delve deep into their lair and put an end to the cultists' rituals once and for all!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are Rooms [ruins]4 & [ruins]8. Pick one at random each time you enter. Set them aside when you start the Quest; you won't use them during other encounters.

records.printedFlavorText: Those once majestic works are turned to odious cesspools. Save them, purify them, deliver them from evil!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are [ruins]3. Add 3 [potion] to your starting Provisions if possible. When in an Objective Room, the Healing Fountain does not function unless a Hero spends 2 actions and 1 [potion] when there to purify it. Objective Rooms are cleared only if the Healing Fountain has been purified. Set aside the room [ruins]3 at the start of the quest; you will not use it in other meetings.

records.printedFlavorText: Their numbers have increased as they infest more Rooms, turning them into lairs. This must be stopped lest the entire ruins get overrun by these Monsters. Enter the ruins and ransack their hideouts, make them pay for what they've caused.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: An abyssal influence is spreading among the ruins, beckoning more followers into undeath and eternal servitude. Nothing can be done unless their numbers are reduced, for the undead never tire and will never cease to threaten your very existence.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Whenever an Unholy Monster is spawned, Heroes suffer [stress]+1 each.

records.printedFlavorText: Your biggest expedition to the Darkest Dungeon will only succeed if you set up some forward camps. Venture deep into the ruins and set up those camps, lest you fall prey to tiredness and darkness.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Use a [torch] or a [tool] in Empty Rooms to set up forwards camps. To set up this Dungeon, use 3 Empty Rooms and randomize non-Objective rooms for the rest.

records.printedFlavorText: The gates of oblivion have opened, spouting forth horrible nightmares that call the ruins their lair. Enter those dens, obliterate their denizens and deliver these halls from evil!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Do not spawn any Level 1 Monsters in Lairs

records.printedFlavorText: Treachery will never rest, even unto death. For recent reports have shown that a group of undead soldiers roam the ruins' halls. They bear the arms and insignia of an old band of turncoats. 'Tis only a matter of vengeance, as the owner has asked you to find them and eradicate them, once and for all!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Objective Room spawn a Bone Captain who has +20 Life and +2 Dodge

records.printedFlavorText: The dark recesses of the ruins house even more sinister and potent shadows. We must light up the hall's torches, bringing light and warmth, courage and hope. Thus you are tasked, with torches in hand and a righteous purpose.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: After rolling for Provisions, each Hero may turn one of them into a [torch]. Use a [torch] in Dark Rooms to light them up (in addition to its standard effect) and clear them.

records.printedFlavorText: Not only have the beasts increased their numbers, but they are also arming themselves with stolen armaments from the guards they kill. They must be storing them, somewhere beneath our feet. Venture deep into the warrens' bowels, find their storage room and put it to the flames.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Room is always Room [warrens]6. Spawn only [warrens] Monsters there.

records.printedFlavorText: The vast sewer network has lied abandoned for far too long. Yet some sinister forces gather in its deep shadows. Enter the sewers and map them out. Make sure you learn part of their layout for future expeditions.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: The villagers have lived in constant fear for far too long. Some brave souls entered the warrens to combat the evil that resides within, never to return. Their relatives beg of you to go there, find their bodies and bring back the trinkets and mementos that belonged to them. A small consolation for their loss.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Spawn only Rooms with Loot Chests in Lairs. The first chest you Loot in each Lair contains a Level 2 Trinket. Returning to the Hamlet, you may return any trinkets of level 2 acquired in the dungeon (up to a maximum of 3 trinkets).

records.printedFlavorText: These swine abominations have festered the warrens for far too long. Enter the warrens, find their quarters and give them none! Eradicate their lair, lest they eradicate us!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: Feral beasts known as the carrion eaters have begun to emerge on the surface from the depths of the warrens below. Their numbers must have increased from the amount of corpses littering their halls. Enter the dark murky warrens, find them, and eradicate them.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Room is always Room [warrens]8. Spawn a Large Carrion Eater (LvL 2) when starting a battle there.

records.printedFlavorText: Lately reports have mentioned a new breed of swinefolk, more potent, hardened and resistant to diseases. If their genes are passed down through their kind, we're doomed. Search for these beasts and bring an end to their kind. It's either them or us...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Warrens Monsters are immune to Conditions.

records.printedFlavorText: It is widely known that these gluttonous beasts crave food above all else. Take some extra bundles and head into the warrens. Lure them out from the shadows and kill them all, especially the malevolent swine skiver.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Before entering the Dungeon, gain 3 additional [food]. When in an empty Room, you may spend a [food] to bait a Swine Skiver (LvL 3). Start battle immediately in a random Room with a Swine Skiver, then roll a [d10]: 1-4 spawn 2 additional monsters of normal or small size, 5-8 spawn 3 additional monsters of normal or small size, 9-10 nothing.

records.printedFlavorText: Things have gotten out of hand, as buried corpses start to disappear. This means that the carrion beasts have grown rampant. No matter how many you put to the sword, it won't be enough. Find their breeding grounds and smash their eggs. Make sure no single maggot stays alive...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Objective Rooms, spawn one Large Carrion Eater and two Carrion Eaters. When a Large Carrion Eater dies, replace it immediately with a Carrion Eater. When a Carrion Eater dies, replace it immediately with a Maggot. The fight ceases and the room is secured as soon as there are only Maggots left in play.

records.printedFlavorText: We've mounted so many expeditions to the sewers, yet we haven't mapped them adequately. You still have to do this perilous task, for it is of utmost importance that we know where our enemies dwell and where they're coming from.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.

records.printedFlavorText: Never ever have these filthy beasts acted as disciplined as they do now. It's apparent that one of them has won their trust. A dark leader that forms them up in regiments, and soon to be an army. Bring that beast's reign to an end, once and for all.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Room is always Room [warrens]9. Spawn a Swine Skiver (LvL 3) and a Large Carrion Eater there, plus a random monster of normal or small size to fill the Stances. The Battle ends immediately once the Swine Skiver is killed.

records.printedFlavorText: Among their kind, there is an alpha swine - a monster that the swines idolize. A Swinetaur that poses a threat far more dangerous than any that you have overcome. Go there, find it and kill it as soon as possible. Expect a strong resistance though, for the swines will fervently defend their new alpha like a rabid pack of wolves.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Lairs, always spawn a Swinetaur. [warrens] Monsters in Lairs have +1 Crit

records.printedFlavorText: Filth, rot and humidity are the primary enemies we have yet to overcome in the warrens. Their halls festering with disease such that even the air is toxic. Enter these halls, and find the toxic lairs from where this disease emanates. Expect time to be your primary enemy as your provisions will run bad, faster than expected.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: After you leave a Room, choose and discard a Provision.

records.printedFlavorText: Do you hear them? These are their drums of doom... Coming from deep in the warrens, the swine are gathering for their dark masses. Your mission is of utmost importance, for you need to go down there and eradicate as many drummers as possible. Drag their bodies, along with their morale, to the muddy, rancid ground.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Always spawn a Swine Drummer in Lairs. The first Monster you spawn after this gains [guard]4t. When it dies, the remaining [guard] goes to the next Monster in Stance priority order. When a Swine Drummer is activated in Lairs, all Monsters gain [buff]2t, [buff]2t.

records.printedFlavorText: You have suffered many things, but the worst is yet to come. In the warrens there is a foul room filled with rancid smell and pestilence. A fitting start for a new plague... Find this room and solve this problem. Be careful, though, as the new disease is far more contagious than expected.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Room is always Room [warrens]6. When a Hero is dropped to Death's Door when fighting there, they suffer [disease].

records.printedFlavorText: Like humans often do, the swine are fighting each other, amidst a heated leader crisis. Now is the time to brave the shadows of the warrens and move unseen. Strike fast and bring down the strongest of their kind!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Always spawn a Swine Skiver in Lairs. You cannot Scout in this Quest. Instead, before advancing to a Room, you can reveal one adjacent. If you move towards a revealed Lair, move there without exploring. For the first round in each Lair, place all Hero Initiative Cards on top of the deck.

records.printedFlavorText: The cackling of these mad crones can still be heard through the dark woods. People are already afraid of them and their malevolent rituals. Venture through the Weald, and stop their horrific seance.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Room is always room [weald]9. Spawn a Crone (LvL 2) when Battle starts there.

records.printedFlavorText: Not even the vegetation of the Weald can stand against the seeping corruption of the evil that lives deep in its groves. Majestic oaks have been tainted, but they can still be saved. Take potions and pour them onto their roots. Let the healing magic undo what the dreadful darkness has done to these majestic trees.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Room is always room [weald]5. Start this Quest with 3 additional [potion] Provisions. A Hero must spend one action and a [potion] when in Area [red-area] of the Objective Room to disinfect the oak.

records.printedFlavorText: The weald is a mysterious place, thus we know so little of its denizens and plants. Rumor has it that a mysterious type of fungus grows in its dark crevasses. Thus, you need to collect as many samples as you can to be tested. We only hope that they give us further insight as to what we have to combat.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are rooms [weald]3, [weald]6 & [weald]8. Upon entering, randomly choose one and discard it once secured. Win Battles there with at least one unsmashed Necrotic Fungus to gain the objective.

records.printedFlavorText: People are afraid of the Weald as it stands dark, foreboding and unwelcoming. We need light, we need you. Traverse the dark groves and look out for the danger that lurks within its foliage. Eradicate the monsters and ensure that we sleep yet one more night...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: When Battle starts, roll a [d10]. If you rolled over your [light] Level, place all Monster Initiative Cards on top of the deck for the first round of Battle.

records.printedFlavorText: Vicious monsters litter the grounds of the Weald, and yet we stand helpless against their brutality. No more. Head in there, amidst the trees, find and eradicate them. Bring an end to their madness and hope to our hearts.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Spawn only [weald] Monsters in Lairs.

records.printedFlavorText: The howling you hear from deep within the woods belongs to the rabid mongrels that hunt in the night. No game can be found, for our hunters are hunted down by these malevolent predators. Deal with them, lest we die of starvation.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Rooms are Rooms [weald]1, [weald]3 & [weald]6. Upon entering, randomly choose one and discard it once secured. Spawn 3 Rabid Gnashers there.

records.printedFlavorText: A convoy filled with much desirable supplies should have arrived a moon ago. Yet we dare not enter the outskirts of the Weald. Can you brave the danger, traverse the woods and find the convoy? What happened to it? Are there any supplies that you can bring back to us safe and intact?
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Do not roll for Provisions for this Quest other than those gained by the Survivalist or other Skills. Use only Rooms with Loot Chests for this Quest. When looting a Chest, roll for two random Provisions instead of their normal Loot. When returning to the Hamlet and gaining Xp for the Provisions you brought back, you'll also gain the 1[gold] per Provision as normal.

records.printedFlavorText: Glimmering in the dark is the loot that the fiendish monsters have managed to collect. All tokens of their attacks against our Hamlet. These lost treasures are ours though, and you will bring them back to us. We implore you, take them from their clutches and bring them back to our Hamlet in honor to those who have fallen in service to our safety.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Treasure Rooms, spawn only Level 2 Monsters.

records.printedFlavorText: What lies ahead underneath the mantle of darkness? Venture through the cursed woods, find out what dangers lie in wait, and deal with them once and for all!
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Fill the rest of the Room slots with random Rooms. Spawn only [weald] Monsters in Lairs.

records.printedFlavorText: The Hag's dark blessings are only spread by one of her hateful agents, the dreaded Virago. One that brings desolation and despair over the Weald. A harbinger of doom, death and decay. Find her, kill her, bring her reign to an end.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Objective Rooms spawn a Hateful Virago (LvL 3).

records.printedFlavorText: The monsters of the woods have grown restless, corrupting anything they touch. These horrific abominations shouldn't be left undisturbed. Venture into the Weald, find them and kill them all. But beware, because even a scratch from their claws can be lethal...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: When you spawn a [weald] Monster in Battle, all Heroes suffer 1[blight] 2t.

records.printedFlavorText: Those tremors you feel are unnatural, coming from the great unclean giants that live deep within the Weald. Are you brave enough to go into the forest, find them and kill them?
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: In Objective Rooms, spawn an Unclean Giant. These elder giants have 2 actions per round, so shuffle an additional Initiative Card in the Initiative Deck for them.

records.printedFlavorText: Sometimes corruption seeps deep into one's skin beyond salvation, and even the trees are not an exception. These proud oaks once infected should be burned down to the ground. Otherwise, if a malevolent spirit possesses them, it might be too late for us all...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: Objective Room is always room [weald]5. A Hero must spend an action and a [torch] when in Area [red-area] to set the oak ablaze. Heroes must wait until the end of the next round for the oak to burn. This means it cannot be done during round 4. At the end of the round that the Heroes set the oak on fire, fill all empty Stance slots with new Monsters. If the oak burns, the objective is cleared even if there are still Monsters at the end of round 4.

records.printedFlavorText: Deep within the woods, there is a grove where stench and decay contaminates the air around it. These poisonous, noxious vapours will bring an end to us all. Find that place and eradicate it. Burn it to the ground. But hold your breath while doing so, lest you get infected for good...
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: When a Monster in a Lair is killed, all Heroes suffer 2[blight] 2t, 2[blight] 2t.

records.printedFlavorText: The murmurs in the wind originate from the haunted Weald. The whispering woods beckon all of us to our doom. Little can be done, and only you can bring an end to this nightmare. Heed the call, follow the murmurs and fell the cursed trees lest they drive us all insane.
records.objectiveObservation: No separate Objective heading; qualification is printed in XP and Special Rules panels.
printedSpecialRules: At the start of each Battle round, Heroes suffer [stress] +1.
